headline:
$1M+ sales up 22.6%.
Total sales down 4.5%.
[[Same county. Same month.]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: One market is accelerating. The other is cooling. Price for the one you're actually in.
sources: MIAMI REALTORS + RWorld, August 2026 county data

stats.label: $1M+ home sales in Broward climbed year over year in August, 255 closings versus 208.
Total home sales fell across every price point, down to 1,899 closings countywide.
Condo sales dropped the hardest of any segment tracked, while single family barely moved.
